features.summary: AXI4 full-protocol slave port (AW/W/AR/B/R): per-channel FIFO queuing, single-clock (no CDC in c_model).
Converts AXI awaddr/araddr to NoC dst_id + local_addr using XY-extraction, SourceRouting, or IDRouting (SAM table lookup).
Assembles AXI AW/W/AR transactions into NoC request flit streams (header + payload), tagging dst_id, src_id, awid/arid, flit_tail, and ordering_tag.
Maps outbound flits to a VC at flit-construct time (req-VC=0, rsp-VC=0 for NUM_VC=1), and stamps fixed_vc on the ordering_req=0 AW streak so routers keep that VC instead of restamping at VA.
Round-robin arbitration across populated VCs at NMU REQ_OUT egress. Selects which VC's flit is emitted onto the NoC link each cycle, subject to per-VC credit availability.
Per-AXI-ID response handling on B and R paths. Disabled: admission filter (same-id different-dst stalls), responses pass in arrival order. Enabled: ordering_tag slot pool, in-order commit per ID.
Parses inbound response flits into AXI B/R beats (with last) for the AXI slave port; reads ordering_req/ordering_tag to hand the beat back to the RoB.
Shared NI wormhole arbiter, 3 inputs (AW, W, AR) with the AW->W pairing lock: an AW flit (flit_tail=0) locks it to W until the flit_tail=1 beat drains, so AW+W stays one packet. AR never locks.
AXI4 full-protocol master port (AW/W/AR/B/R): per-channel FIFO queuing, single-clock (no CDC in c_model).
Parses inbound NoC request flit streams into AXI AW/W/AR transactions before delivery to the AXI master port.
Snapshots request flit metadata (ordering_tag, src_id, awid/arid) on AW/AR flit reception; retrieved at response injection time to reconstruct the return path.
Assembles AXI B/R beats from the local slave into NoC response flit streams, using META_BUFFER for dst_id / ordering_tag / bid|rid return-path reconstruction.
Round-robin arbitration across populated VCs at NSU RSP_OUT egress. Selects which VC's response flit is emitted onto the NoC return link, subject to per-VC credit availability.
Shared NI wormhole arbiter, 2 inputs (B, R), no channel pairing: every response flit carries flit_tail=1, so the lock engages degenerately and the stage is flit-level round-robin.

blocks.name: ROUTER
blocks.role: Per-node wormhole switch, one instance per physical network: REQ/RSP are 2-stage ready/valid single-VC SimpleRouters, DAT is a 3-stage credit Router with per-hop VC assignment

features.summary: XY dimension-order route computation on the head flit; minimal, deterministic, no Y-to-X turns.
Per-output packet-level lock ACROSS VCs, head grant to tail grant; RR advances per packet. A credit-starved worm idles the whole output. AW+W is the only packet whose lock spans cycles.
DAT only: per-output VC-major, input-minor round-robin, credit-gated, plus the VA stage assigning the output VC (preferred map + FVADA overflow) and restamping vc_id on fixed_vc=0 flits.
DAT only: per-(output port, vc) credit counters seeded with downstream depth, reserved at grant, registered 1-cycle return. REQ/RSP use an almost-full ready computed off occupancy.
A collective_op != UNICAST head takes the multi-hot route_mask_fork branch set instead of the one-hot route; each branch grants on its own, and the input pops once every branch has accepted.
RSP only: a CollectB leaves unicast arbitration and is forwarded once, whole, when every route_mask_join input holds a head of that collect. BRESP precedence is first-SLVERR, DECERR never elevated.
Optional route_par screen at ingress; mismatch drops the flit and counts.
